interface.name: df_core
interface.description:
The one private global every session client may bind. It carries no state of its own beyond the handshake result. Binding it does not grant access; only a successful authenticate does.
On success the compositor emits `authenticated` and the private chrome/window/workspace/output globals become bindable. On failure it emits `refused` and disconnects the client; the attempt is logged.

request.name: authenticate

description.summary: present a one-time launch token and lockstep version

request.description: Present the launch token provisioned to this process out-of-band at startup, plus the lockstep version this build speaks. Tokens are one-time: a token that was already consumed, or that was minted by a previous boot, is refused. The token must never be sent on a shared or replayable channel.

arg.name: lockstep_version
arg.summary: the private-protocol set version this client speaks

description.summary: the client is trusted for this session

event.name: refused

description.summary: the handshake failed; the client will be disconnected

event.description:
The refusal codes are stable and additive-only:
0 invalid-token — no such token, or a token from another boot 1 token-consumed — the one-time token was already redeemed 2 version-mismatch — lockstep sets disagree 3 not-provisioned — no launch token was ever minted for this role 4 already-authenticated — this client already authenticated
